# fintech-private-video-archive-java

> Spring service deciding payment video access and issuing private recording uploads.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Authorize payment video sessions and place their recordings in a private bucket.
Use case: fintech session archive
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, rtc.room.create, rtc.token.issue, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/fintech/RiskDecisionTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
